info.title: IP Threat Intelligence API - VPN, Proxy & Tor Detection with Threat Scoring
info.description: Retrieve real-time threat intelligence and security signals for a single IPv4 or IPv6 address. Returns an aggregate `threat_score` (0-100) plus detection flags and provider names for VPNs, proxies (including residential proxies), Tor exit nodes, relays, known attackers, bots (with bot type and whether it is a declared, known-good bot), spam sources, cloud-provider ranges, and corporate security gateways. Use `fields`/`excludes` with dot notation (e.g. `security.threat_score`) to trim the response to only the modules you need. If `ip` is omitted, the API returns threat data for the public IP of the requesting client. Bogon and reserved IP addresses return a `423` error, and malformed IP input returns a `400` error, instead of partial data.

get.summary: Retrieve real-time threat intelligence and security signals for an IPv4 or IPv6 address
get.description: Get a threat score along with VPN, proxy, Tor, relay, bot, spam, known-attacker, and cloud-provider detection flags for an IP address.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to check for threat intelligence and security signals. If omitted, the public IP of the requesting client is used.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return. Supports dot notation (e.g. `security.threat_score`).

parameters.name: excludes
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to remove from the response. Supports dot notation (e.g. `security.is_tor`). The `ip` field is always included and cannot be excluded.

400.description: Bad Request — Invalid or missing IP address

value.message: Provided IP address 'invalid' is not valid

423.description: Locked — Bogon or reserved IP address

ApiKeyAuthHeader.name: X-apiKey
ApiKeyAuthHeader.description: Pass your API key via the X-apiKey request header.

ApiKeyAuthQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyAuthQuery.description: Pass your API key via the apiKey query parameter.

error.description: Short error category or exception type.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing the failure.

path.description: API endpoint path that produced the error.

status.description: HTTP status code returned with the error.

IpSecurityResponse.description: Threat intelligence result for an IP address.

ip.description: The IP address used for the lookup (IPv4 or IPv6).

Security.description: Threat intelligence and security information for the IP.

is_tor.description: true if the IP matches a Tor exit node.

is_proxy.description: true if the IP is associated with a proxy service.

proxy_last_seen.description: Last observed proxy activity date in YYYY-MM-DD.

is_residential_proxy.description: true if the IP is linked to a residential proxy network.

is_vpn.description: true if the IP is associated with a VPN service.

vpn_last_seen.description: Last observed VPN activity date in YYYY-MM-DD.

is_relay.description: true if the IP is associated with a relay network.

is_anonymous.description: true if any anonymity signal is present.

is_known_attacker.description: true if the IP is flagged for known attacker behavior.

is_bot.description: true if the IP is associated with bot activity.

bot_confidence_score.description: Bot detection confidence from 0 to 100. 0 unless is_bot is true.

bot_operator_name.description: Organization running the bot, when known (mostly declared bots).

bot_type.description: Kind of bot activity, when known. Declared bots (is_known_good_bot true): search_engine, ai_crawler, ai_assistant, seo_crawler, site_monitor, link_preview, feed_fetcher, archiver, ad_verification, scanner. Undeclared bots (is_known_good_bot false): scanner, scraper, exploit, credential_stuffing, brute_force, worm. New values can be added over time, so treat it as a plain string.

is_known_good_bot.description: true if the bot is a declared bot with a verifiable operator (e.g. a search engine crawler or uptime monitor).

bot_last_seen.description: Last observed bot activity date in YYYY-MM-DD, when available.

is_spam.description: true if the IP is associated with spam activity.

is_cloud_provider.description: true if the IP belongs to a cloud provider range.

is_corporate_gateway.description: true if the IP is an outbound address of a corporate security gateway (SWG, SSE, or SASE).

corporate_gateway_type.description: Kind of corporate gateway, when known. Known values: secure_web_gateway, browser_isolation.

corporate_gateway_provider_name.description: Corporate gateway provider name, when known.

X-AF-Credits-Cost.description: Specifies the number of credits consumed by the current request.
